description: Sets up a sending subdomain (the caller's host, e.g. mail) for the email EcomverX's products (UpverX, PayverX, EcomverX Core) send through Resend: the DKIM key, the bounce MX, SPF, the return-path CNAME and the click-tracking CNAME. The apex DMARC is deliberately absent: a template cannot add one only where none exists.
variableDescription: dkimkey: the base64 public key Resend issued for this domain DKIM record, without its leading p=. region: the domain Resend region, as in feedback-smtp.<region>.amazonses.com (us-east-1 today). rsend: the label before .rmta.net in the domain return-path CNAME (send.forge today). links: the label before .resend-dns.com in its click-tracking CNAME (links2 today).
